stem: A company is implementing a new network architecture and needs to consider the requirements and considerations for training and inference. Which of the following statements is true about training and inference architecture?
explanation:
C 最合适：训练通常关注完成模型训练所需的时间，交互式推理则需要满足响应时间目标；两者都需要足够的吞吐量以及合适的硬件和软件。
C is the best fit: training often targets time to a trained model, while interactive inference must meet a response-time target. Both still need sufficient throughput and suitable hardware and software.

options.text: Training architecture and inference architecture have the same requirements and considerations.
options.translationZh: 训练架构与推理架构的要求和考虑因素完全相同。

options.text: Training architecture is only concerned with hardware requirements, while inference architecture is only concerned with software requirements.
options.translationZh: 训练架构只关注硬件要求，推理架构只关注软件要求。

options.text: Training architecture is focused on optimizing performance while inference architecture is focused on reducing latency.
options.translationZh: 训练架构侧重优化性能，推理架构侧重降低延迟。

options.text: Training architecture and inference architecture cannot be the same.
options.translationZh: 训练架构与推理架构不可能相同。

sources.title: NVIDIA: training and inference
sources.supports: Training adjusts model weights; inference uses learned weights to process new inputs.

sources.title: Triton Model Analyzer: online and offline modes
sources.supports: Online inference can optimize throughput subject to a latency budget; offline inference can optimize throughput without a real-time constraint.

outline:
先区分构建模型与提供预测服务。
Distinguish model building from serving predictions.

比较典型优化重点，而不是把资源需求割裂开。
Compare typical optimization priorities, not exclusive resource requirements.

排除“只关注”或“绝不可能相同”等绝对表述。
Reject absolute claims such as only or cannot.
analysis.whyChoose:
C 最合适：训练通常关注完成模型训练所需的时间，交互式推理则需要满足响应时间目标；两者都需要足够的吞吐量以及合适的硬件和软件。
C is the best fit: training often targets time to a trained model, while interactive inference must meet a response-time target. Both still need sufficient throughput and suitable hardware and software.

whyNotChoose.text: Training architecture and inference architecture have the same requirements and considerations.
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：即使共用基础设施，长时间训练任务与交互式预测服务也可能有不同的延迟、可用性和扩展目标。
Incorrect: a long-running training job and an interactive prediction service can have different latency, availability and scaling targets even on shared infrastructure.

whyNotChoose.text: Training architecture is only concerned with hardware requirements, while inference architecture is only concerned with software requirements.
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：训练除了硬件还需要框架和分布式软件；推理同样需要计算、内存与网络资源。
Incorrect: training needs frameworks and distributed software as well as hardware; inference also needs compute, memory and networking.

whyNotChoose.text: Training architecture and inference architecture cannot be the same.
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：同一批 GPU 服务器或集群可以支持两个阶段。针对工作负载进行调优，不意味着必须采用物理上分离的架构。
Incorrect: the same GPU servers or cluster can support both stages. Workload-specific tuning does not require physically separate architectures.

stem: For which workloads is NVIDIA Merlin typically used?
explanation:
选 A：Merlin 面向推荐系统，例如为用户召回候选内容并排序。
Choose A: Merlin is designed for recommender systems, such as retrieving and ranking items for a user.

options.text: Recommender systems
Natural language processing
Data analytics

sources.title: NVIDIA Merlin: recommender workflows
sources.supports: Merlin targets recommender pipelines, including preprocessing, feature engineering, training and inference.

outline:
识别产品的目标应用：个性化推荐。
Identify the product’s target application: personalized recommendations.

把目标应用与支撑它的数据处理环节区分开。
Separate that application from supporting data-processing steps.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 A：Merlin 面向推荐系统，例如为用户召回候选内容并排序。
Choose A: Merlin is designed for recommender systems, such as retrieving and ranking items for a user.

whyNotChoose.reason:
不是最佳答案：文本特征可以用于推荐，但 Merlin 的定位不是通用语言处理框架。
Not the best answer: text features can contribute to recommendations, but Merlin is not defined as a general language-processing framework.

范围过宽：分析与预处理服务于推荐流程，而其明确的目标应用是推荐。
Too broad: analytics and preprocessing support the workflow; the specific target application is recommendation.

stem: Which NVIDIA parallel computing platform and programming model allows developers to program in popular languages and express parallelism through extensions?
explanation:
选 A：CUDA 是底层并行平台与编程模型；cuML 和 cuGraph 是位于其上的专用库。
Choose A: CUDA is the underlying parallel platform and programming model; cuML and cuGraph are specialized libraries built above that layer.

options.text: CUDA
CUML
CUGRAPH

sources.title: CUDA Programming Guide: GPU and CPU design goals
sources.supports: CUDA enables general-purpose GPU computing. GPU design favors many parallel threads and high aggregate throughput; CPUs favor fast individual threads and also execute threads in parallel.

sources.title: CUDA Programming Guide
sources.supports: CUDA is a parallel computing platform and programming model with language extensions including C++ and Python.

sources.title: RAPIDS / CUDA-X data science API documentation
sources.supports: cuML implements machine-learning algorithms, cuDF handles data frames, and cuGraph provides graph analytics.

outline:
抓住“平台”和“编程模型”这两个关键词。
Notice the paired terms platform and programming model.

排除面向特定算法类别的库。
Eliminate libraries named for a specific class of algorithms.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 A：CUDA 是底层并行平台与编程模型；cuML 和 cuGraph 是位于其上的专用库。
Choose A: CUDA is the underlying parallel platform and programming model; cuML and cuGraph are specialized libraries built above that layer.

whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：cuML 提供机器学习算法，利用 GPU 平台运行，而不是取代 CUDA 的通用编程模型。
Incorrect: cuML supplies machine-learning algorithms. It uses the GPU platform rather than replacing CUDA’s general programming model.

错误：cuGraph 面向关系与连通性等图处理工作负载，不是通用 GPU 语言扩展平台。
Incorrect: cuGraph focuses on graph-processing workloads such as relationships and connectivity, not general GPU language extensions.

stem: Which of the following aspects have led to an increase in the adoption of AI? (Choose two.)
explanation:
选 C、D：强大的并行算力使更大的模型具备可行性，丰富的数据则为模型提供学习样本。
Choose C and D: powerful parallel compute makes larger models practical, and abundant data provides examples from which they can learn.

Rule-based machine learning.
High Powered GPUs.
Large amounts of data.

sources.supports: Large datasets and GPU parallel computation support the training of complex neural networks.

stem: Which of the following statements is true about GPUs and CPUs?
explanation:
选 A：GPU 偏重大量线程的总吞吐量；CPU 偏重单线程快速执行与灵活的控制流。
Choose A: GPUs favor aggregate throughput across many threads; CPUs favor fast execution of individual threads and flexible control flow.

options.text: GPUs are optimized for parallel tasks, while CPUs are optimized for serial tasks.
options.translationZh: GPU 针对并行任务优化，而 CPU 针对串行任务优化。

options.text: GPUs have very low bandwidth main memory while CPUs have very high bandwidth main memory.
options.translationZh: GPU 的主存带宽很低，而 CPU 的主存带宽很高。

options.text: GPUs and CPUs have the same number of cores, but GPUs have higher clock speeds.
options.translationZh: GPU 与 CPU 的核心数量相同，但 GPU 的时钟频率更高。

options.text: GPUs and CPUs have identical architectures and can be used interchangeably.
options.translationZh: GPU 与 CPU 的架构相同，可以互换使用。

sources.title: CUDA Programming Guide: GPU and CPU design goals
sources.supports: CUDA enables general-purpose GPU computing. GPU design favors many parallel threads and high aggregate throughput; CPUs favor fast individual threads and also execute threads in parallel.

outline:
比较设计目标，而不是只看一个主频数字。
Compare design goals rather than a single clock-speed number.

排除架构相同或核心数量固定相等的说法。
Reject claims of identical architecture or fixed equal core counts.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 A：GPU 偏重大量线程的总吞吐量；CPU 偏重单线程快速执行与灵活的控制流。
Choose A: GPUs favor aggregate throughput across many threads; CPUs favor fast execution of individual threads and flexible control flow.

whyNotChoose.text: GPUs have very low bandwidth main memory while CPUs have very high bandwidth main memory.
whyNotChoose.reason:
作为一般比较不正确：GPU 通常用高设备内存带宽支撑大量运算单元。主机到设备的连接带宽是另一个指标。
Incorrect as a general comparison: GPUs commonly provide high device-memory bandwidth to feed many arithmetic units. Host-to-device link bandwidth is a different measurement.

whyNotChoose.text: GPUs and CPUs have the same number of cores, but GPUs have higher clock speeds.
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：核心数量相同、GPU 主频更高都不是通则；CPU 核心与 GPU 执行单元也不能直接等同。
Incorrect: neither equal core counts nor higher GPU clock rates is a general rule. A CPU core and a GPU execution unit are also not directly equivalent.

whyNotChoose.text: GPUs and CPUs have identical architectures and can be used interchangeably.
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：不同的执行与存储设计需要相应的软件和工作负载映射。GPU 不能取代 CPU 的所有职责。
Incorrect: different execution and memory designs require suitable software and workload mapping. A GPU does not replace every CPU responsibility.

summary.zh: 选 A：GPU 偏重大量线程的总吞吐量；CPU 偏重单线程快速执行与灵活的控制流。

memory.en: GPU: many similar operations together. CPU: fast, flexible individual threads.
memory.zh: GPU：大量相似操作一起算；CPU：单个线程执行快、控制灵活。

pitfall.en: CPUs also support parallelism through multiple cores and vector instructions. GPU acceleration depends on the workload and data-movement cost.
pitfall.zh: CPU 也通过多核和向量指令实现并行。GPU 是否加速取决于工作负载与数据搬运成本。

steps.en: Compare design goals rather than a single clock-speed number.
steps.zh: 比较设计目标，而不是只看一个主频数字。

steps.en: Reject claims of identical architecture or fixed equal core counts.
steps.zh: 排除架构相同或核心数量固定相等的说法。

A.zh: GPU 针对并行任务优化，而 CPU 针对串行任务优化。

reason.en: Best answer as a design comparison. Read optimized for as a preference, not a ban on CPU parallel execution or GPU sequential dependencies.
reason.zh: 作为设计取向对比，这是最佳答案。“针对……优化”表示侧重点，并非否认 CPU 并行执行或 GPU 中的顺序依赖。

B.zh: GPU 的主存带宽很低，而 CPU 的主存带宽很高。

reason.en: Incorrect as a general comparison: GPUs commonly provide high device-memory bandwidth to feed many arithmetic units. Host-to-device link bandwidth is a different measurement.
reason.zh: 作为一般比较不正确：GPU 通常用高设备内存带宽支撑大量运算单元。主机到设备的连接带宽是另一个指标。

C.zh: GPU 与 CPU 的核心数量相同，但 GPU 的时钟频率更高。

reason.en: Incorrect: neither equal core counts nor higher GPU clock rates is a general rule. A CPU core and a GPU execution unit are also not directly equivalent.
reason.zh: 错误：核心数量相同、GPU 主频更高都不是通则；CPU 核心与 GPU 执行单元也不能直接等同。

D.zh: GPU 与 CPU 的架构相同，可以互换使用。

reason.en: Incorrect: different execution and memory designs require suitable software and workload mapping. A GPU does not replace every CPU responsibility.
reason.zh: 错误：不同的执行与存储设计需要相应的软件和工作负载映射。GPU 不能取代 CPU 的所有职责。

stem: Which phase of deep learning benefits the greatest from a multi-node architecture?
explanation:

Choose B in the assumed large-workload setting: training can distribute repeated computation across nodes to reduce time to solution.

Training
Inference

whyNotChoose.reason:

stem: Which type of GPU core was specifically designed to realistically simulate the lighting of a scene?
explanation:
选 C：RT Core 加速确定光线与场景几何体的交点，这是逼真光线追踪照明的重要环节。
Choose C: RT Cores accelerate finding where rays intersect scene geometry, a key part of realistic ray-traced lighting.

options.text: Tensor Cores
CUDA Cores
Ray Tracing Cores
options.translationZh: Ray Tracing Core 光线追踪核心。

sources.title: NVIDIA Turing architecture: RT and Tensor Cores
sources.supports: RT Cores accelerate BVH traversal and ray intersection tests; shader execution remains on SMs. Tensor Cores accelerate matrix operations.

outline:
识别专用光线追踪操作，而不是泛指图形能力。
Identify the specialized ray-tracing operation, not general graphics capability.

把求交与遍历工作对应到 RT 硬件。
Match intersection and traversal work to RT hardware.

whyNotChoose.reason:

Incorrect for the named specialization: Tensor Cores accelerate matrix operations. AI reconstruction may improve a rendered image, but it is not ray-intersection hardware.

outline:
关注训练，而不是车端推理。

explanation:

sources.title: PyTorch FSDP: sharded training state
sources.supports: FSDP shards parameters, gradients and optimizer states across workers to save memory at the cost of communication.

outline:
把问题定位到训练内存，而不是服务请求量。
Locate the problem in training memory, not serving demand.

选择分布策略时考虑参数、梯度、激活值与优化器状态。
Account for parameters, gradients, activations and optimizer state when choosing a distribution strategy.
analysis.whyChoose:

whyNotChoose.text: The model is being used by a large number of users
whyNotChoose.reason:
不符合训练问题：大量用户主要增加服务并发需求，应通过推理容量规划处理。
Incorrect for the training question: many users primarily create serving-concurrency demand, which can be handled by inference capacity planning.

whyNotChoose.text: The model is being used for large scale inference workloads
whyNotChoose.reason:
范围不对：它解释的是扩展推理，而不是单个训练任务为何需要分布存放模型状态。
Incorrect scope: this explains scaling inference, not why an individual training job needs distributed model state.

learning.stemHtml: A customer is evaluating an AI cluster for training and is questioning why they should use a large number of nodes. Why would multi-node training be advantageous?客户评估用于训练的 AI 集群，想了解为何要使用多个节点。多节点训练有什么优势？
learning.keyPointHtml:
选 A：分片或模型并行训练可以分布存放单个设备容不下的模型与训练状态。
Choose A: sharded or model-parallel training can distribute a model and training state that do not fit on one device.
learning.speedTipHtml:
内存不足 → 分割训练状态，不是只增加副本。
Memory limit → partition the training state, not just add replicas.
studyNotesHtml:
数据并行复制会在每个工作进程保存模型副本。跨节点容量只有配合合适的分割策略和足够的互连能力才能发挥作用。
Data-parallel replication keeps a model copy on each worker. Multi-node capacity helps only with a compatible partitioning strategy and adequate interconnect.

stem: An IT Professional is considering whether to implement an on-prem or cloud infrastructure. Which of the following is a key advantage of on-prem infrastructure?
explanation:
按“直接控制数据位置、物理访问与安全运维”的含义选 C。本地部署不会自动使数据安全。
Choose C in the sense of direct control over data location, physical access and security operations. On-premises deployment does not automatically make data secure.

options.text: Lower upfront costs and capital expenditure
options.translationZh: 更低的前期成本与资本支出。

options.text: Scalability and flexibility
Ensure data security and sovereignty
options.translationZh: 确保数据安全与数据主权。

options.text: Easy remote management.

sources.title: AWS: cloud versus on premises
sources.supports: On-premises ownership provides direct control and entails capital investment and maintenance; cloud access reduces upfront infrastructure acquisition.

outline:
把所有权与控制能力作为区别。
Identify ownership and control as the distinguishing benefit.

不要把控制能力误当成安全保证或更低的初始成本。
Do not confuse control with a security guarantee or lower initial cost.

Usually not the advantage: buying and installing infrastructure requires upfront resources; cloud services commonly lower that initial acquisition barrier.

不是最强的区分点：本地系统可以扩展，但新增硬件可能需要采购与安装，而云容量通常可按需配置。
Not the strongest differentiator: local systems can scale, but additional hardware may require procurement and installation, while cloud capacity is often provisioned on demand.

不是本地部署独有的特点：两种模式都能远程管理，具体取决于管理工具与安全连接。

steps.en: Do not confuse control with a security guarantee or lower initial cost.
steps.zh: 不要把控制能力误当成安全保证或更低的初始成本。

A.zh: 更低的前期成本与资本支出。

reason.en: Usually not the advantage: buying and installing infrastructure requires upfront resources; cloud services commonly lower that initial acquisition barrier.
reason.zh: 通常不是优势：购买与安装基础设施需要前期投入；云服务通常能够降低初始采购门槛。

reason.en: Not the strongest differentiator: local systems can scale, but additional hardware may require procurement and installation, while cloud capacity is often provisioned on demand.
reason.zh: 不是最强的区分点：本地系统可以扩展，但新增硬件可能需要采购与安装，而云容量通常可按需配置。

C.zh: 确保数据安全与数据主权。

reason.en: Intended answer, with a wording caveat: ownership gives direct control over where and how data is handled. Security and sovereignty outcomes still require effective design, governance and operation.
reason.zh: 预期答案，但措辞需加限定：拥有基础设施可直接控制数据在哪里、如何被处理；安全与主权目标仍需要有效的设计、治理和运维。

reason.en: Not unique to on premises: remote management is possible in both models and depends on management tooling and secure connectivity.
reason.zh: 不是本地部署独有的特点：两种模式都能远程管理，具体取决于管理工具与安全连接。

stem: Which feature of RDMA reduces CPU utilization and lowers latency?
explanation:
选 B：支持 RDMA 的适配器通过硬件处理传输与直接内存放置，减少主机软件工作。
Choose B: an RDMA-capable adapter handles transport and direct memory placement in hardware, reducing host software work.

options.text: Increased memory buffer size.
Network adapters that include hardware offloading.

sources.supports: RDMA-capable adapters transfer data directly between memories; RoCE carries RDMA over Ethernet.

sources.title: RoCE in the Data Center
sources.supports: Explains hardware transport offload, OS bypass and reduced CPU copying overhead. Used for architecture, not its historical speed figures.

outline:
判断哪个组件执行实际传输。

stem: What is one key advantage that Cloud GPU Infrastructure has over On-Prem GPU infrastructure?
explanation:
选 A：租用 GPU 容量使用户不必在开始前购买整套系统。长期成本仍取决于使用方式与服务条件。
Choose A: renting GPU capacity avoids purchasing the whole system before starting. Long-term cost still depends on usage and service terms.

options.text: Lower cost barrier to entry.
Reduced cost of I/O traffic.
options.translationZh: 更低的 I/O 流量成本。

options.text: Greater flexibility for hardware orchestration.
options.translationZh: 更高的硬件编排灵活性。

sources.title: AWS: cloud versus on premises
sources.supports: On-premises ownership provides direct control and entails capital investment and maintenance; cloud access reduces upfront infrastructure acquisition.

outline:
区分前期硬件采购与持续服务支出。
Separate upfront hardware acquisition from ongoing service expenditure.

不要假定云中每种 I/O 路径或物理定制都更便宜、更灵活。
Avoid assuming that every I/O path or physical customization is cheaper or more flexible in the cloud.

whyNotChoose.reason:

stem: When training a neural network, what is the most common pattern of storage access?
explanation:
B 是给定选项中最接近的答案：训练通常反复读取数据集。但物理读取是顺序还是随机，取决于格式、采样方式与缓存。
B is the closest offered answer: training commonly reads datasets repeatedly. However, whether physical reads are sequential or random depends on format, sampling and caching.

options.text: Random write
Sequential read
Sequential write

sources.title: DGX SuperPOD storage architecture
sources.supports: Most DL workloads are read-dominant, but storage must also support small random I/O, checkpoints and varied data formats.

outline:
先区分读取训练样本与写入结果。
First distinguish ingesting examples from writing results.

选择唯一的读取选项，同时识别题目缺少“随机读取”这一备选项。
Choose the only read option, while recognizing the missing random-read alternative.

whyNotChoose.reason:

检查点或日志可能顺序写入，但它们属于输出，不代表通常以读取为主的输入流程。
Checkpoints or logs may use sequential writes, but these are outputs and do not describe the usual read-heavy input pipeline.

stem: How many distinct network fabrics are in an AI cluster?
explanation:
按对应的 SuperPOD 设计选 C：计算、存储、带内管理与带外管理，共四类网络。
Choose C for the referenced SuperPOD design: compute, storage, in-band management and out-of-band management make four fabrics.

sources.title: DGX H100 SuperPOD: network fabrics
sources.supports: This reference architecture explicitly lists compute, storage, in-band management and out-of-band management fabrics.

outline:
回忆参考设计，不要把它扩展成所有集群的规则。
Recall the reference design rather than inventing a universal cluster rule.

分别计算计算网络、存储网络、带内管理与面向 BMC 的带外管理。
Count compute, storage, in-band management and BMC-oriented out-of-band management separately.
analysis.whyChoose:
按对应的 SuperPOD 设计选 C：计算、存储、带内管理与带外管理，共四类网络。

按对应的 SuperPOD 设计选 C：计算、存储、带内管理与带外管理，共四类网络。
Choose C for the referenced SuperPOD design: compute, storage, in-band management and out-of-band management make four fabrics.
learning.speedTipHtml:
两类业务网络＋两类管理网络＝四类。
Two workload fabrics + two management fabrics = four.
studyNotesHtml:
这个数量属于特定参考架构。其他集群可以合并角色或划分更多网络；统计线缆或 VLAN 数量是另一个问题。
This count belongs to a reference architecture. Other clusters may converge roles or separate additional networks; counting cables or VLANs answers a different question.

回忆参考设计，不要把它扩展成所有集群的规则。
Recall the reference design rather than inventing a universal cluster rule.

分别计算计算网络、存储网络、带内管理与面向 BMC 的带外管理。
Count compute, storage, in-band management and BMC-oriented out-of-band management separately.

options.explanation:
对于该设计不正确：按三类统计通常合并了两种管理角色，而引用的架构将它们分开。
Incorrect for this design: a three-role count often merges the two management roles, but the cited architecture separates them.

stem: How many 1 Gb Ethernet in-band network connections are in a DGX H100 system?
explanation:
选 C，零个：文档中的 1 GbE RJ45 接口用于 BMC 带外管理，不是系统带内网络。
Choose C, zero: the documented 1 GbE RJ45 interface is for out-of-band BMC management, not the in-band system network.

sources.title: NVIDIA DGX H100/H200 hardware guide
sources.supports: Distinguishes the 1 GbE BMC interface from faster system interfaces and documents power, physical and environmental requirements.

outline:
同时按“1 GbE”和“带内”两个条件筛选接口。
Filter interfaces by both 1 GbE and in-band.

排除 BMC 端口，因为它属于带外管理。
Exclude the BMC port because it is out of band.

选 C，零个：文档中的 1 GbE RJ45 接口用于 BMC 带外管理，不是系统带内网络。

whyNotChoose.reason:

固定题目指定的系统与网卡代际。

stem: Which is the best PUE value for a data center?
explanation:
选 A，1.2：它是这些选项中最小、最接近理想值 1.0 的比值。
Choose A, 1.2: it is the smallest ratio and closest to the ideal 1.0 among these choices.

options.text: PUE of 1.2
PUE of 3.5
PUE of 5.0
PUE of 2.0

sources.title: US Department of Energy: PUE definition
sources.supports: PUE is total facility energy divided by IT equipment energy; its theoretical minimum is one.

outline:
四个数都使用同一个分母：IT 能耗。
Apply the same denominator, IT energy, to all four values.

选择高于理想基准 1 且最小的数值。
Choose the lowest value above the ideal baseline of one.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 A，1.2：它是这些选项中最小、最接近理想值 1.0 的比值。
Choose A, 1.2: it is the smallest ratio and closest to the ideal 1.0 among these choices.

whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：每单位 IT 能耗对应 2.5 单位附加能耗，明显高于 PUE 1.2。
Incorrect: overhead is 2.5 units per IT unit, substantially higher than at PUE 1.2.

错误：每单位 IT 能耗对应 4 单位附加能耗，是列表中最大的附加能耗比。
Incorrect: overhead is 4 units per IT unit, the largest overhead ratio in the list.

错误：附加能耗等于 IT 能耗，总能耗为 IT 能耗的两倍，不如 A 的 1.2 比值。
Incorrect: overhead equals IT energy, giving twice the total energy per IT unit rather than the 1.2 ratio available in A.

learning.stemHtml: Which is the best PUE value for a data center?下列哪个数据中心 PUE 值最好？
learning.keyPointHtml:
选 A，1.2：它是这些选项中最小、最接近理想值 1.0 的比值。
Choose A, 1.2: it is the smallest ratio and closest to the ideal 1.0 among these choices.
learning.speedTipHtml:
PUE＝设施总能耗÷IT 能耗；越接近 1，设施附加能耗越少。
PUE = facility energy ÷ IT energy; closer to one means less facility overhead.
studyNotesHtml:
PUE 为 1.2 时，附加能耗是 IT 能耗的 20%，不是设施总能耗的 20%。仅凭低 PUE 不能证明 AI 计算本身高效。
At PUE 1.2, overhead is 20% of IT energy, not 20% of total facility energy. Low PUE alone does not prove efficient AI computation.

选择高于理想基准 1 且最小的数值。

stem: What is a key benefit of using NVIDIA GPUDirect RDMA in an AI environment?
explanation:
选 B：在受支持的传输中，网卡到 GPU 内存的直接路径避免主机内存中转，减少拷贝开销并可能降低延迟。
Choose B: the NIC-to-GPU memory path avoids host-memory staging for supported transfers, reducing copying overhead and potentially latency.

options.text: It increases the power efficiency and thermal management of GPUs.
options.translationZh: 提高 GPU 的电源效率与散热管理能力。

options.text: It reduces the latency and bandwidth overhead of remote memory access between GPUs.
options.translationZh: 减少 GPU 之间远程内存访问的延迟与带宽开销。

options.text: It enables faster data transfers between GPUs and CPUs without involving the operating system.
options.translationZh: 无需操作系统参与，就能加速 GPU 与 CPU 之间的数据传输。

options.text: It allows multiple GPUs to share the same memory space without any synchronization.
options.translationZh: 允许多个 GPU 无需任何同步就共享同一内存空间。

sources.supports: GDS provides direct DMA between storage and GPU memory, avoids a CPU-memory bounce buffer on supported paths, retains a CPU control path and has compatibility fallbacks.

outline:

端点不符：GPU 对等访问不是用于读写本地或远程存储的这一特性名称。

stem: What is an advantage of InfiniBand over Ethernet?
explanation:
C 是预期答案：InfiniBand 面向低延迟通信设计。实际比较仍取决于适配器、交换机、软件与工作负载。
C is the intended answer: InfiniBand is designed for low-latency communication. Actual comparisons depend on adapters, switches, software and workload.

options.text: InfiniBand always provides higher bandwidth than Ethernet.
options.translationZh: InfiniBand 的带宽始终高于以太网。

options.text: InfiniBand supports RDMA while Ethernet does not.
options.translationZh: InfiniBand 支持 RDMA，而以太网不支持。

options.text: InfiniBand offers lower latency than Ethernet.
options.translationZh: InfiniBand 的延迟低于以太网。

sources.supports: InfiniBand targets low latency and high throughput with communication offload.

sources.title: NVIDIA Dynamo: RDMA fabric types
sources.supports: RDMA is available on both InfiniBand and Ethernet through RoCE.

outline:
排除跨未指定产品的“带宽始终更高”说法。
Reject always-higher-bandwidth claims across unspecified products.

记住 RoCE，不要把 RDMA 当成 InfiniBand 独有能力。
Remember RoCE before treating RDMA as exclusive to InfiniBand.

stem: In a data center, what is the purpose and benefit of a DPU?
explanation:
选 D：DPU 把基础设施服务从主机应用 CPU 转移出去，提供可编程加速与隔离。
Choose D: a DPU moves infrastructure services away from the host application CPU and provides programmable acceleration and isolation.

options.text: A DPU is responsible for providing backup and disaster recovery solutions.
options.translationZh: DPU 负责提供备份与灾难恢复方案。

options.text: A DPU is used for managing physical infrastructure, such as power and cooling.
options.translationZh: DPU 用于管理供电与散热等物理基础设施。

options.text: A DPU is responsible for managing network connections and security.
options.translationZh: DPU 负责管理网络连接与安全。

options.text: A DPU is designed to offload, accelerate, and isolate infrastructure workloads.
options.translationZh: DPU 用于卸载、加速并隔离基础设施工作负载。

sources.title: NVIDIA BlueField: DPU definition
sources.supports: A programmable infrastructure processor can offload, accelerate and isolate networking, storage and security services from the host.

outline:

Identify the infrastructure-service category, including networking, storage and security.

选择解释架构价值的答案，而不是只列出一个用途。

analysis.whyChoose:
选 D：DPU 把基础设施服务从主机应用 CPU 转移出去，提供可编程加速与隔离。

Too narrow and not defining: a DPU may assist data services, but it is not primarily a complete backup and disaster-recovery product.

whyNotChoose.reason:
类别不对：设施供电与散热管理不是这里 DPU 所指的可编程网络、存储与安全服务角色。
Incorrect category: facility power and cooling management are not the programmable network, storage and security service role meant by DPU.

whyNotChoose.text: A DPU is responsible for managing network connections and security.
whyNotChoose.reason:

stem: What is a key advantage of dynamic, priority-based job scheduling in an AI cluster?
explanation: Priority-based scheduling helps manage limited GPU/compute resources by giving urgent or business- critical workloads earlier access during resource contention, aligning cluster usage with SLAs and workload importance.

options.text: It operates completely independently of job priority, user role, or service-level objectives defined for different workloads.
It is designed primarily for lightly utilized or idle clusters, where there is little or no contention for resources.
It ensures time-critical or high-priority workloads receive prompt access to constrained compute resources when contention occurs.
It allocates identical resource shares to every submitted job, regardless of workload type or business impact.

stem: What distinguishes an edge AI deployment from cloud-based deployments?
explanation: Edge AI runs inference or processing near where data is generated, such as cameras, sensors, or local devices. This reduces latency, bandwidth use, and dependency on sending all data to a centralized cloud.

options.text: Eliminates need for network management.
Processes data close to the source.
Relies solely on CPU for all computation.
Requires higher-capacity GPUs at every site.

stem: Which of the following is a best practice for addressing model drift in AI operations?
explanation: Model drift happens when real-world data changes over time, reducing model accuracy. The best practice is to monitor model performance continuously and retrain or update the model using current, representative data.

options.text: Increase hardware resources when accuracy drops.
Monitor deployed models regularly and retrain with fresh data.
Permit changes in input data distributions over time.
Allow the model to generalize to any data.
